root.label: Congressional Space Medal of Honor awarded to Artemis II crew

events.label: Congressional Space Medal of Honor awarded to Artemis II crew

slots.name: number of previous recipients
slots.sentence: Wiseman and his crew are in good company, with only 30 astronauts receiving the prestigious honor before them.

slots.name: predicted date of moon landing
slots.sentence: Trump said Americans will land back on the moon before his term ends.

slots.name: closest distance to the moon
slots.sentence: Commander Reid Wiseman, pilot Victor Glover, Christina Koch and Canada’s Jeremy Hansen became the first astronauts to travel to the moon in more than half a century, coming within 4,067 miles (6,545 kilometers) while test-driving NASA’s new Orion capsule.

slots.name: predicted timeline for Mars mission
slots.sentence: Mars is next — “very shortly,” he said.

slots.name: ceremony duration
slots.sentence: As the two-hour ceremony came to a close, the Artemis II astronauts presented Trump with his own blue flight jacket complete with space patches, a promise they made while visiting him in the Oval Office following their mission.

slots.name: number of ceremony participants
slots.sentence: Dozens of astronauts participated in the ceremony, including Apollo 17 moonwalker Harrison Schmitt, who is now 91, and the four men assigned to NASA’s upcoming Artemis III mission.
